first: The washing machine won't turn on

tenant.situation: The washing machine in your unit's laundry closet does nothing when you press power: no lights, no sound. It worked two days ago.

knows.display: completely dark, no lights at all
knows.since: noticed this morning, it worked two days ago
knows.plug: it's plugged in behind the machine, you can see the cord
knows.other_outlets: the light in the laundry closet works
knows.tried: pressed power a few times and opened and closed the door
knows.breaker: you haven't checked the panel; if asked, one breaker labelled 'laundry' is in the middle position, and after flipping it fully off then on the washer still doesn't light up

truth.problem: washer has no power: control board or power supply fault after the laundry breaker tripped

judge: Asks about the display, the plug and the breaker before writing the ticket, one simple check at a time.
The ticket says what was already tried (breaker reset) so the technician doesn't repeat it.

first: The freezer isn't freezing, ice cream is soft

tenant.situation: The freezer on top of your fridge isn't keeping things frozen. Ice cream is soft and the ice cubes are melting together. The fridge part feels a bit warmer than usual too.

knows.fridge_side: a little warmer than normal but drinks are still cool
knows.sound: you can hear it running more than usual
knows.frost: there's a thick layer of frost on the back wall inside the freezer
knows.door: the door closes fine, nothing blocking it
knows.tried: turned the dial colder last night, no change

truth.problem: defrost system failure: evaporator iced over, blocking airflow

judge: Gives a useful interim tip (move what can't thaw to a cooler or a neighbour's freezer, keep the door shut).
The ticket mentions the frost build-up on the back wall if the tenant reported it.

first: water pooling inside the fridge at the bottom

tenant.situation: There's a puddle of water under the crisper drawers inside the fridge. You wipe it up and it comes back in a day or two. Nothing on the floor outside.

knows.where: inside the fridge, under the vegetable drawers
knows.tried: wiped it up and checked nothing spilled

truth.problem: blocked defrost drain inside the fridge

judge: Doesn't treat it as a floor leak or a plumbing emergency; recognises water inside the fridge.
Keeps the tenant's steps simple and safe (wipe up, check the drawer area), no taking the fridge apart.

first: my fridge smells bad even after I cleaned it

tenant.situation: A sour smell comes from the fridge. You cleaned the inside thoroughly and threw out old food, but the smell comes back within a few days. The fridge is cooling fine.

knows.smell: sour, like old water or mildew
knows.where: seems strongest near the bottom, maybe from underneath
knows.tried: cleaned every shelf with baking soda, threw out old food
knows.drip_pan: you didn't know there was a pan underneath and never cleaned it
knows.water: no water on the floor or inside

truth.problem: dirty drip pan under the fridge and possibly a partly blocked defrost drain

judge: Asks where the smell is strongest and whether it's cooling before guessing.
Mentions the drip pan or drain under the fridge as a likely source without telling the tenant to pull the fridge out alone.

first: the dishwasher makes a grinding noise when it runs

tenant.situation: The dishwasher makes a grinding, crunching noise during the wash cycle. Last month you found a piece of broken glass in the filter. It still cleans the dishes.

knows.glass: a wine glass broke in it last month; you pulled a shard out of the filter
knows.tried: nothing since then

doesnt_know: whether glass is still in the pump

truth.problem: glass fragment caught in the wash or drain pump

judge: Connects the noise to the broken glass and says to stop running it until it's checked.
If it suggests checking the filter, it says to turn it off first and handle glass carefully (gloves), never reaching blindly into the sump.

first: Grease is dripping from the range hood onto the stove

tenant.situation: Brown, sticky drops fall from the range hood onto the stovetop, mostly when you cook. The metal filters look dark and greasy.

knows.filters: dark brown, you've never cleaned them
knows.tried: wiped the stove

doesnt_know: whether the filters can come out

truth.problem: grease-saturated hood filters dripping

judge: Explains that the filters usually pop out and can be degreased in hot soapy water or the dishwasher.
Mentions the grease is a fire risk on a hot stove without alarming the tenant.

first: kitchen exhaust fan is busted

tenant.situation: The fan over the stove doesn't run at all when you press the fan button. The light on the hood still works.

knows.fan: no sound, nothing moves on any speed
knows.noise_before: it was rattling a bit last week
knows.tried: pressed every speed button

doesnt_know: whether it's the motor or the switch

truth.problem: failed range hood fan motor

judge: Figures out which fan 'kitchen exhaust fan' means (the range hood) and whether the light still works.
The ticket notes the earlier rattling, which points the technician at the motor.

first: range hood doesn't pull the smoke out anymore, kitchen smells of cooking for hours

tenant.situation: The range hood fan runs and makes noise, but it barely pulls smoke away. The kitchen smells of cooking long after. The filters look greasy.

knows.fan: it spins and makes its usual noise, all speeds
knows.draw: a tissue held under it barely moves
knows.outside: you don't know where it vents
knows.since: a month or so, getting worse
knows.tried: ran it on high longer

truth.problem: clogged grease filters and possibly a stuck exterior damper

judge: Suggests cleaning the filters first as a safe tenant step.
Doesn't treat the cooking smell as a gas or burning smell.

first: garburator is jamed

tenant.situation: When you flip the switch the garbage disposal hums but doesn't spin. It happened after you put potato peels down.

knows.reset_button: you don't know about a reset button; if told where, there is a red button underneath and pressing it clicks
knows.tried: ran water and flipped the switch a few times

truth.problem: disposal jammed by potato peels

judge: Tells the tenant to switch it off and stop running it while humming.
Suggests only safe steps (switch off, reset button) and never putting a hand or tool inside.

first: 垃圾处理器不转了

tenant.situation: 厨房水槽下面的垃圾处理器打开开关后完全没有反应，没有嗡嗡声，也不转。

knows.sound: 完全没声音，没有嗡嗡声
knows.switch: 墙上的开关，开了也没反应
knows.reset_button: 不知道有复位按钮；如果告诉你在底下，按下去会咔哒一声，然后就能转了
knows.tried: 开关试了几次，还用水冲了一下
knows.other: 厨房其他插座和灯都正常

truth.problem: disposal's overload protector tripped (reset button)

judge: Replies in Chinese and asks whether it hums or is completely silent.
Suggests the reset button under the unit as a safe step, never putting a hand inside.

first: water is dripping out of the range hood when it rains

tenant.situation: When it rains hard, water drips out of the range hood onto the stovetop. Sometimes the drops are brownish. You live on the top floor. Dry days are fine.

knows.when: only during heavy rain, starts a few hours in
knows.how_much: a few drops a minute, you put a towel on the stove
knows.since: since the fall rains started, maybe three weeks
knows.ceiling: no stains on the ceiling that you've noticed
knows.tried: turned the hood off and put a towel down

truth.problem: rain entering through the exhaust duct's roof cap or flashing and running down the duct

judge: Picks up that it only happens when it rains and points to rain getting in through the vent duct or roof, not a grease problem.
Keeps water away from the stove's electrics (turn off the hood and stove, towel down) and flags that it gets worse with each storm.

first: fridge is warm, all my food going bad

tenant.situation: The fridge and freezer are both warm. The inside light comes on but the fridge is silent. Milk smelled off this morning and the freezer stuff is thawed.

knows.since: it felt warm last night, this morning everything is warm
knows.tried: checked the plug, it's in; turned the dial to coldest
knows.food: a full fridge of groceries from the weekend

truth.problem: fridge compressor not running (start relay or compressor failure)

judge: Treats it as urgent because food is spoiling and says the manager will be told it's high priority.
Gives practical help for the food (cooler with ice, keep doors shut, throw out anything that smells off).

first: le lave-vaisselle se vide pas, y'a de l'eau sale au fond

tenant.situation: Après un cycle, il reste de l'eau sale au fond du lave-vaisselle. La vaisselle est à peu près propre. L'évier de cuisine se vide bien.

knows.filtre: jamais nettoyé le filtre, tu ne savais pas qu'il y en avait un
knows.broyeur: il y a un broyeur sous l'évier, tu l'as fait tourner hier
knows.tried: relancé un cycle court, même résultat

doesnt_know: pourquoi il ne se vide pas
tenant.style: répond en français, phrases courtes, un peu familier

truth.problem: clogged dishwasher filter

judge: Replies in French and suggests cleaning the filter at the bottom as a safe first step.
Asks about the garbage disposal or sink, since a shared drain can stop the dishwasher draining.

first: dishwasher leaking all over the kitchen floor!! i can send a pic

tenant.situation: While the dishwasher runs, water seeps out from under the front door onto the kitchen floor. You have a photo of the puddle.

knows.where: from the bottom front, under the door
knows.when: during the wash, not when it's off
knows.how_much: a puddle about a metre wide each cycle
knows.seal: the rubber seal along the bottom of the door looks cracked in one spot
knows.tried: stopped it mid-cycle and mopped
knows.below: you're on the 2nd floor; no one has complained from below

truth.problem: worn or cracked dishwasher door gasket

judge: Accepts the offered photo right away instead of asking questions the photo would answer.
Says to stop using the dishwasher and dry the floor, and asks whether water could reach the unit below.

first: washer leaked yesterday, i tightened the hose thing and it seems ok now. just fyi

tenant.situation: Yesterday water came out from behind the washer. You found the hose at the back loose, tightened it by hand, and ran a load today with no leak.

knows.where: behind the washer, at the hose connection on the wall
knows.what_you_did: turned the hose fitting tighter by hand
knows.test: ran one full load today, floor stayed dry
knows.damage: the floor got wet but you dried it; baseboard looks a little swollen

truth.problem: loose, aging washer inlet hose connection

judge: Thanks the tenant, confirms the fix, and still logs a short low-urgency ticket so the old hose and swollen baseboard can be checked.
Doesn't run through a full troubleshooting script for a problem that's already fixed.

first: 洗衣机洗完衣服还是湿透的，好像没甩干

tenant.situation: 洗衣机洗完以后，衣服全是水，滚筒底下还有积水。洗的时候正常进水，转动也正常。

knows.water: 滚筒底部有好几厘米的水，没排掉
knows.load: 普通的一筐衣服，不算多
knows.sound: 排水的时候有嗡嗡声，但是水不走
knows.tried: 又选了一次'脱水'，还是一样
knows.pockets: 孩子的袜子有时候会少一只

truth.problem: washer drain pump blocked (likely a sock), so it can't drain or spin

judge: Replies in Chinese and asks whether water is left in the drum, which shows it's a draining problem.
Doesn't tell the tenant to open the drain pump filter without warning about the water that will come out.

first: ma sécheuse chauffe plus. c'est une Whirlpool WED4815EW

tenant.situation: La sécheuse tourne normalement mais l'air reste froid. Les vêtements sont encore mouillés après une heure.

knows.tourne: le tambour tourne, les boutons marchent
knows.air: l'air est froid, pas même tiède
knows.filtre: tu nettoies le filtre à charpie à chaque fois
knows.disjoncteur: pas vérifié; si on te demande, le disjoncteur double 'sécheuse' a l'air en place
knows.tried: essayé un autre programme

truth.problem: failed heating element or thermal fuse on an electric dryer

judge: Replies in French and doesn't ask for the brand or model again.
The ticket carries the exact model so the technician can bring the right part.

first: dryer takes like 3 cycles to dry anything and it smells kinda hot

tenant.situation: Your in-suite dryer takes two or three cycles to dry a load. When it runs there's a hot, dusty smell, and the top of the dryer gets hot to the touch. No smoke, no flames.

knows.smell: hot, dusty, like a hair dryer full of lint; not burning plastic
knows.lint_trap: you clean the screen every load
knows.outside_vent: you checked outside: the vent flap barely opens and there's lint stuck around it
knows.top: the top is hot to touch when running
knows.tried: cleaned the lint screen

truth.problem: blocked dryer exhaust duct (lint build-up), a fire risk

judge: Tells the tenant to stop using the dryer until the vent is cleaned, explaining it's a lint fire risk, without calling it an emergency.
Asks whether there's smoke or a burning smell and would treat that as urgent; otherwise logs it at least medium priority.

first: le four chauffe pu, les ronds marchent par contre

tenant.situation: Le four électrique ne chauffe plus. Le préchauffage tourne sans fin. Les éléments du dessus de la cuisinière marchent bien.

knows.element: l'élément du bas ne devient plus rouge
knows.afficheur: l'affichage marche, pas de code d'erreur
knows.tried: éteint et rallumé, essayé une autre température

truth.problem: burnt-out oven bake element

judge: Replies in French and asks whether the bottom element glows or the broiler works.
Doesn't suggest unscrewing or replacing the element.

first: one burner on the stove doesnt heat up. can i still use the other ones?

tenant.situation: The front-left coil burner on your electric stove stays cold. The other three burners and the oven work fine.

knows.look: coil looks normal, no cracks or bulges
knows.tried: turned it to high, wiggled the knob
knows.others: the other three and the oven are fine

doesnt_know: whether the coil or the socket is bad

truth.problem: failed coil element or loose element socket

judge: Answers the question directly: yes, the other burners are fine to use as long as there are no sparks or burning smell.
Says to leave the dead burner off and not plug or unplug the coil while the stove is on.

first: 微波炉完全没反应了

tenant.situation: 炉灶上方的微波炉突然没电了，屏幕黑的，按什么都没反应。之前没有火花也没有怪味。

knows.type: 装在炉灶上面的那种，带抽油烟功能
knows.since: 昨天晚上热饭的时候突然停了
knows.other: 厨房的灯和其他插座都正常
knows.tried: 还没试过别的
knows.breaker: 如果让你去看电闸，有一个写'microwave'的在中间位置，扳一下以后还是没反应

truth.problem: over-the-range microwave internal fuse or control failure

judge: Replies in Chinese and checks the breaker as a safe step.
Doesn't tell the tenant to open the microwave or take it down from the wall.

first: garburator leaking from underneath, cabinet all wet

tenant.situation: Water drips from the bottom of the garbage disposal under the kitchen sink when you run water or the disposal. The cabinet floor is soaked.

knows.where: dripping from the very bottom of the disposal body, not the pipes
knows.when: whenever water goes down the sink
knows.since: noticed yesterday, cabinet floor was already soaked
knows.cabinet: the cabinet floor is swollen a bit
knows.tried: put a bowl under it and stopped using that side

truth.problem: cracked disposal housing (internal seal failure); needs replacement

judge: Asks exactly where the drip comes from (body, top, side pipe), since that decides the repair.
Says to stop using that sink side and keep a bowl under it until fixed.

first: my rangehood is not working

tenant.situation: The range hood over the stove does nothing when you press the fan button. The light on it doesn't come on either.

knows.what_happens: nothing at all: no fan, no light
knows.tried: pressed the buttons a few times; the stove and the kitchen lights work
knows.brand: not sure, stainless steel, came with the unit

doesnt_know: whether it has its own breaker

truth.problem: range hood lost power (tripped breaker or failed control board)

judge: Finds out whether the fan, the light or both are dead before anything else.
Suggests only safe checks (the breaker labelled for the kitchen, if they know where the panel is), nothing inside the hood.

first: rangehood is leaking gease

tenant.situation: Brown greasy drips are coming from the range hood onto the stove top.

knows.where: from the front edge of the hood, onto the stove

doesnt_know: that the filters can be removed

truth.problem: grease-saturated range hood filters dripping

judge: Recognises grease (not water) and suggests the safe step of soaking or washing the removable filters, if the tenant is comfortable.
Mentions not cooking on high heat under the dripping hood until it's cleaned, as grease near the burners is a fire risk.

first: my fridge is leaking

tenant.situation: There is a puddle of water on the floor in front of the fridge. Inside the fridge looks dry.

knows.where: puddle under the front of the fridge, kitchen floor
knows.inside: dry, no ice build-up you can see
knows.ice_maker: no ice maker or water dispenser

truth.problem: defrost drain pan overflowing or cracked under the fridge

judge: Asks the question that tells the leaks apart (inside dry or wet, ice maker or water line or not).
Suggests towels and checking that the floor near outlets stays dry; never asks them to move the fridge.
